mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates and boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions, as lower rates increase present value of future cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE signal dual economic stress from monetary tightening and labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened recession risk.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE rises, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 500.0 thousand units signal strong residential investment that drives consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 500.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions that increase consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases over prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 95.0 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profitability and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal broad economic slowdown from reduced demand and output, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST declines and INDPRO declines, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer price index exceeding 210.0 (CPIAUCSL) indicates high inflation that erodes real corporate earnings and prompts central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 210.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.
